lineage.prior_result: AU parity and conditional one-packet failed FIT eligibility. Retained negative; both AU DEV unopened.

source.split_rule: first 12 seed IDs per vector for FIT, last 12 for SCREEN; do not construct SCREEN until frozen FIT configuration chosen
source.source_birth: unchanged parent AO paired graph and original 24 demonstrations, plus evaluator-issued deterministic public input queries for Ygg augmentation only
source.extra_query_corruption_rule: flip exactly output bit (index+seed)%16 in query positions 6,13,20; fixed before experiment; independently verify six total corrupted public answers
source.source_oracle: Evaluator replies to public input queries; queries and outputs are model-visible training examples. The underlying operator name, inverse, graph labels and true answer are never model inputs.
source.DEV: Frozen identities only; no DEV source constructor in this gate

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Public query informativeness limits inverse identification, distinguish identifiable affine relations from out-of-class nonlinear Feistel. Contrast same-size active-designed and randomly queried 48-demo support sets using source-blind learned affine inverse and original small-24 control.
Yggdrasil.training: Public 48 demos split 40 FIT and 8 CHECK; deterministic robust affine 17-row RANSAC max 256 attempts. Fit from public examples only, inverse learned via GF2 linear algebra. Compare original 24-demo baseline (20 FIT,4 CHECK). No operator-family label to learner. Report matrix GF2 rank, FIT mapping quality, CHECK 16-bit correctness, abstention, paired cases by operator family.
Yggdrasil.eligibility: Within original TRAIN-FIT source identities and honest new query access: FP0, paired positive at least 1, strictly outperform strongest sourceblind control; then freeze exactly one candidate and run held TRAIN-SCREEN. No DEV in this gate.
Yggdrasil.resource_cost: 48 public demos, extra query/evaluator calls, 256 RANSAC attempts and task coefficients counted above 16 cognition cells.

Wingless.hypothesis: A non-retained within-hop source-blind lookahead coherence penalty may reduce spurious negative acceptance without erasing baseline-positive long chains.
Wingless.implementation: Exact original 12bit one-packet state code with frozen additive per-step penalty based on weak next-step packed-affinity evidence; candidate score and state folded into same existing scalar accumulator, never retain a second packet or history.
Wingless.eligibility: On TRAIN-FIT: strictly lower FP, paired >= original, and every baseline-accepted >=13-hop positive accepted; freeze one candidate then check untouched TRAIN-SCREEN with same rules. If none qualifies do not screen candidate or open DEV.
Wingless.normalization: Evaluator-only source normalization applied equally to original and learned handoff candidate; not end-to-end source operator inference
Wingless.cost: Extra ephemeral lookahead compares count ops, CPU and memory; no persistent rival state
